proof_0433.moves: Structural induction on the red-black node together with a three-way case split on the comparison Ordering, showing each branch of ins preserves the Ordered invariant; the actual case work sits in a generated helper.

proof_0434.moves: Observe that b2 is a sublist of b1 ++ b2 (sublist_append_of_sublist_right applied to Sublist.refl), then invoke that WellFormedBasis is inherited along sublists.

proof_0435.moves: Exhibit a colimit cocone for the span: take the pushout cocone built by pushoutIsPushoutOfEpiComp out of the existing pushout's inl/inr, then conclude HasColimit via HasColimit.mk'.

proof_0436.moves: Split the iff; the forward direction turns openness of a sublevel/superlevel set into a neighborhood statement via IsOpen.mem_nhds, the reverse rewrites the nhds condition back to openness, with simp normalizing the set-builder form.

proof_0437.moves: Unfold toUSize/toBitVec64 and rewrite with the known description of (x.toUSize).toBitVec, then push the rewrite under the BitVec width cast by congruence and close by reflexivity.

proof_0438.moves: Introduce the hypothesis n+1 <= 0 and observe no constructor of Nat.le can produce it; the whole proof is the vacuous case analysis, packaged in a generated match.

proof_0439.moves: Case on the walk being non-nil (so it has a penultimate vertex) and read off adjacency from the final edge of the walk; the case analysis lives in a generated proof helper.

proof_0440.moves: Pure equality transport: substitute the assumed equalities of iterator and body (including a heterogeneous one), push them under the binder with congruence, and close by reflexivity. There is no mathematical content beyond the congruence assembly.

proof_0441.moves: Unwrap the DHashMap to its underlying Raw0 subtype (carrying the well-formedness field and the positive bucket-count obligation) and apply the corresponding internal Raw0 lemma. The proof is a wrapper transfer.

proof_0442.moves: Transfer the statement along toBitVec, rewriting complement of a UInt8 into complement of its BitVec, then use the BitVec-level commutation of not across an equation; simp closes the resulting iff.

proof_0443.moves: A projection lemma: the X2 component of the short complex sc1 is by definition the stated object, so the proof is definitional unfolding closed by rfl.

proof_0444.moves: Push the statement through the coercion NNReal to Real: nndist x y = 0 iff its real coercion dist x y = 0, then apply dist_eq_zero for a genuine metric space.

proof_0445.moves: Rewrite both Int8 order relations into their defining statements about toInt, then apply transitivity of < with <= on the integers.

proof_0446.moves: Unfold deleteVerts as the induced subgraph on verts minus s, apply the adjacency description of induce, and simplify the resulting set-difference memberships into the conjunctive form.

proof_0447.moves: Apply the criterion for when two drops of a list agree, which reduces the goal to a min identity on Nat (associativity of min plus min n len <= len), discharged by simp.

proof_0448.moves: Transfer the inequality to BitVec via toBitVec, where complement of a nonzero-width bitvector is never equal to itself; the positivity of the platform word size is the needed side condition.

proof_0449.moves: Unfold the extended norm as the ENNReal coercion of the nonnegative norm, then use that the coercion NNReal to ENNReal reflects and preserves the order.

proof_0450.moves: Unwrap the DHashMap into its Raw0 subtype with the well-formedness witness and apply the internal Raw0 lemma that getD returns the fallback when contains is false. A wrapper transfer.

proof_0451.moves: Rewrite prev as posLT (valid because the position is not the start), then apply the characterization of <= against posLT, turning the goal into the strict inequality.

proof_0452.moves: Contrapose the iff: nonempty support fails exactly when the support is empty, and support is empty exactly when the element is zero.

proof_0453.moves: The unit morphism of the trivial group object is by construction the identity of the tensor unit, so the proof is definitional unfolding closed by rfl.

proof_0454.moves: A continuous affine map is differentiable everywhere; weaken global differentiability to differentiability on the given set. One-step forwarder.

proof_0455.moves: The strict betweenness relation on Fin is defined by the circular order instance transported from the stated condition, so the two sides are definitionally equal and Iff.rfl closes it.

proof_0456.moves: In the category attached to a preorder, the top element receives a unique morphism from every object, so it is terminal; conclude by the criterion that an object with unique incoming maps is terminal.
